StructureContourApproximation.ApproximateClosed
Closed integer-contour approximation adapted from OpenCV 4.12.0 approxPolyDP_.
https://github.com/opencv/opencv/blob/4.12.0/modules/imgproc/src/approx.cpp
The helper preserves original solver semantics; the native runtime remains 4.13.0.
License: Apache-2.0 plus the source file's Intel notice;
see OpenCV-LICENSE.txt and OpenCV-4.12-approx-LICENSE.txt.

The Windows slim native package contains statically linked native components.
Their complete build-specific notices must be collected before distributing
a Setup that includes StarMap.Vision. This source experiment is not that Setup.
